articles.title: Kamala Harris HELPED Trump Win 2024? Ex-Democrat Insider 'EXPOSES' Ex-Veep's Biden 'CHARADE'
articles.description: Did Kamala Harris’ political maneuvering inadvertently help Donald Trump win the 2024 presidential election? A former Democratic insider is now making explosive claims about what happened behind the scenes before Joe Biden dropped out of the race. Lindy Li, a former Democratic National Committee fundraiser, claims Harris was privately courting Biden’s donors days before his withdrawal while publicly insisting there was “no daylight” between herself and Biden. Li alleges Harris was preparing for the possibility of replacing Biden even as she told major donors she would support him until the end.
